chapter.p: Treating others as one would like to be treated.1 This instruction is contained in the Answer to Prayer for Covenant: “Judge not others except by the rule you want used to weigh yourself. Pursue judgment whenever the opportunity presents itself. Use judgment to evaluate based upon the standard you want applied to yourself.”2

div.p: 1 “Q&A Session,” April 21, 2019, Grand Junction, CO, transcript, 13.
